en.hubeali: Sahl, from Al Sindy Bin Al Rabi’e, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs a brother of Marazim, from Al Mufazzal who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about something from the Attributes. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not exceed what is in the Quran’.
en.sarwar: 7. Sahl has narrated from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi‘ from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hafs, brother of Marazim from al-Mufaddal who has said
the “I asked Imam abu al-Hassan (a.s.) about certain matters of the attributes (of Allah) and the Imam said, “Do not exceed what is in the holy Quran.”
